text:
Sasha: Quick follow-up after Friday's outage. Want to propose an owner+review ladder and a tighter staleness rule so remediations actually get closed.
Kevin: Good timing. We had several actions with no owner changes for 3+ weeks.
Maria: What's the "review ladder" idea?
Sasha: Two things: 1) Owner roles: Remediation Owner (executes), Review Owner (signs off), and IC (short-term coord). 2) Review ladder: if Remediation Owner doesn't update in X days, escalate to Review Owner; if still stale, escalate to on-call manager.
Aj: What values for X? 7 days seems reasonable for non-P1. P1 shorter.
Priya: Suggestion: P1: owner ETA within 24h, progress update every 48h. P2/P3: ETA within 72h, update every 7d. Stale threshold = 10d for P2/P3, 3d for P1.
Ravi: Ops automation: ops-bot should stamp each action with priority, owner, review owner, and next_required_update. Then auto-escalate if missed.
ops-bot: Ops-bot: will tag cards with priority and schedule nudges. Configured escalations: P1=3d->on-call-manager, P2=10d->review-owner, P3=14d->review-owner.
Kevin: Approvals: Review Owner is required to sign off closure. Closure checklist: deployed fix, smoke test link, postmortem updated, and review-owner signoff.
Maria: Also require a short "why not immediate" note if remediation >30d. Helps exec summaries.
Sasha: IC rotation: 2-week rotation among on-call leads, with a named fallback. IC posts a 3-line handoff in-thread if they rotate mid-incident.
Aj: Put a tiny handoff snippet here to copy: 
```
IC Handoff (3 lines):
- outgoing IC: name; incoming IC: name
- current highest-risk action and owner
- next check-in (datetime TZ)
```
Priya: Board view: OpsBoard should have swimlanes by review-owner and a STALE lane. That way managers can triage escalations quickly.
Ravi: Pattern review: if an incident's closure references similar errors twice in 90 days, flag for a 30m pattern triage with Research/Infra.
Sasha: Pilot: enable these rules for incidents created after the pilot start. Ops team, can you spin up the board and rules?
ops-bot: Ops-bot: created board "Remediation Review Ladder - Pilot". Escalation rules and STALE swimlane enabled. Nudges scheduled per priority.
Kevin: Can we try SLAs as guidance first (not enforced) for 60 days, then tighten?
Sasha: Yes. I'll document the pilot runbook: roles, ladder, SLA guidance, ops-bot config, and closure checklist. Will post in #eng-oncall and invite volunteers.
Maria: I'll review the runbook.
Aj: I'll pilot IC rota for the first two weeks.
Priya: Count me in for review-owner duties during pilot.
Sasha: Thanks all — I'll post the runbook by EOD and enable pilot rules. If anyone else wants to join, reply in-thread.
